story.iWant: a search cascade that combines GraphRAG, wiki article reading, grep, and raw file read in sequence
story.soThat: agents get progressively deeper context: conceptual to compiled to textual to raw

task.title: Create search cascade module
task.subtask: Create /home/ubuntu/scripts/lib/search-cascade.mjs exporting searchCascade(projectId, query, opts)
Define the result type structure: { graphResults[], wikiArticles[], grepMatches[], sourceFiles[] }
Accept options: topK, hops, minSimilarity, grepPatterns[], maxSourceFiles
Import graphSearch from graph-search.mjs for Layer 1

task.title: Implement Layer 1 — GraphRAG search
task.subtask: Call graphSearch(projectId, query, { topK, hops, minSimilarity }) to get vector + traversal results
Extract the list of nodeId values from results to feed into Layer 2
Rank results by similarity score, preserving the full result objects
Handle empty results gracefully (return early with empty cascade result)

task.title: Implement Layer 2 — Wiki article reading
task.subtask: For each nodeId from Layer 1, construct the wiki article path: {knowledgeDir}/{nodeId}.md
Read each wiki article, parsing frontmatter and body sections (Purpose, Dependencies, Dependents, Missing Signals)
Extract source file paths from code-type articles (nodeId maps to actual source file path: replace -- with /, strip .md suffix)
Collect all [[wikilinks]] from articles for context enrichment
Handle missing articles gracefully (stale node warning)

task.title: Implement Layer 3 — Grep precision search
task.subtask: Build a list of source file paths from Layer 2's code-type articles
Run ripgrep (rg) on those specific files for patterns derived from the query and wiki signals
Capture line numbers, matched content, and surrounding context (3 lines before/after)
Support additional grep patterns passed via grepPatterns[] option
Limit grep output to prevent context overflow (max 50 matches per file)

task.title: Implement Layer 4 — Raw file read
task.subtask: From Layer 3's grep results, identify the top files by match density
Read full source code for the top N files (configurable via maxSourceFiles, default 5)
Include file metadata (path, size, last modified) in the result
Return file contents as strings in the cascade result object

task.title: Create CLI wrapper for standalone use
task.subtask: Add CLI entry point that accepts --project, --query, and cascade options
Print each layer's results to stdout with clear layer separators
Support --layer flag to run only up to a specific layer
Support --json flag for machine-readable output

task.title: Integration test with populated Memgraph
task.subtask: Run cascade against a project with nodes in Memgraph and wiki articles on disk
Verify Layer 1 returns relevant nodes
Verify Layer 2 reads corresponding wiki articles
Verify Layer 3 finds code patterns in the identified files
Verify Layer 4 returns full source of the most relevant files

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Layer 1 (GraphRAG): calls graph-search.mjs to return top semantically + structurally related nodes from Memgraph
Layer 2 (Wiki): reads the wiki articles (knowledge/{nodeId}.md) for top-ranked nodes, extracting purpose, decisions, dependencies, and missing signals
Layer 3 (Grep): runs ripgrep on source files for exact pattern matches within the files identified by Layers 1-2
Layer 4 (Read): provides full source code for the specific files targeted for modification
Each layer's results feed into the next layer's targeting (GraphRAG nodeIds to wiki article paths to grep file targets to read file paths)
The cascade is callable as an importable function from daemon pipeline steps (not CLI-only)
The cascade returns a structured result object containing outputs from all four layers

package.name: neo4j-driver
package.purpose: Memgraph connectivity via Bolt protocol (used indirectly through graph-search.mjs)

package.name: ripgrep
package.purpose: System-installed rg binary for Layer 3 grep precision search

constraints.constraint: Layers must execute in strict order: GraphRAG -> Wiki -> Grep -> Read. Each layer feeds results to the next.
Module must be importable as ES module (searchCascade function) and usable as CLI tool
Layer 1 nodeIds feed Layer 2 article paths; Layer 2 source file paths feed Layer 3 grep targets; Layer 3 match-dense files feed Layer 4 reads
Grep output capped at 50 matches per file to prevent context overflow
Layer 4 defaults to max 5 source files to keep context manageable
Wiki article paths use -- for directory separators in code nodeIds (e.g., code/src--components--auth.tsx.md)

interface.returnType: { graphResults: SearchResult[], wikiArticles: WikiArticle[], grepMatches: GrepMatch[], sourceFiles: SourceFile[] }

interface.stdout: Layered results with separators or JSON output
